## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `a602513471817e4928b183ace2358b14b4b7072d`
Local-runs: probe — the dispatch asked for the pins to be re-run and each ruling point ablated: the two pin files at this head in a throwaway worktree (69 passed, 9 of them the ruling pins), ten ablations each restored to the head blob, and two read-only probes (a grid re-pick after branch B, and the held case under branch B)

Face: declaration (`Clause-②: yes (widening)` on the PR body and on `.changeset/36412-currency-change-notes.md`). `record-recognisers.mjs --paths` on the 19 paths decides no face, so the changeset's line decides it. No arm reads `(narrowing)`, so the owed tier is `TIER_DEFAULT`, not `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. No path in the diff hits a governed surface or `packages/spec/src/**`.

### ① Derived judgments

- `@object-ui/fields` reaches `lookupAutofill.ts` through `export * from './widgets/lookupAutofill.js'` in `src/index.tsx`, so everything that file exports is published. The new exports `withheldAutofillNow`, `copiedAutofillNow`, `copiedAutofillMessage` and the type `CopiedAutofill` widen the surface. Right.
- `LookupAutofillPlan.copied?: CopiedAutofill[]` is optional, and `judgePickWrites` omits it when nothing was copied under a judged code. A plan built without it still type-checks. Every reader in the package defaults it: `copied ?? []` twice in `LookupField`, `copied = []` in `GridFieldWidget`, and a conditional spread in `planLookupAutofill`. The pure pin (`not.toHaveProperty('copied')`) holds this. It adds a member and requires nothing. Right.
- `WithheldAutofill.reason` gains `nowSameCurrency`. Widening a union in output position can break a consumer that switches exhaustively, so I checked whether it narrows for consumers. It does not: (a) `git grep` at the head finds no consumer of `WithheldAutofill` or `.reason` outside `ui/packages/fields`. The one reader inside it, `withheldAutofillMessage`, is a ternary chain with a fallback, not an exhaustive switch, and it now handles the new arm. (b) Only the new `withheldAutofillNow` produces the arm. `judgePickWrites`, `planDeclaredLookupAutofill` and `planLookupAutofill` never return it, so an existing caller cannot see it at runtime. (c) The repo already treated this as additive: #36918 added `targetCurrencyUnread` to this union and `unread` to `AmountCurrency` without a `(narrowing)` arm. (d) The changeset names the cost to a consumer that switches over every reason. So the declaration is `yes (widening)`, not a narrowing. Right.
- `judgeCopy` changes its return shape, but it is not exported. `planLookupAutofill` is not in the index's named `GridField.js` export list. Neither is on the surface. Right.
- `@object-ui/i18n` gains `lookup.autofillNowSameCurrency` and `lookup.autofillCopiedUnder` in all 11 packs (ar, de, en, es, fr, ja, ko, pt-BR, ru, zh-Hans, zh-Hant). Each carries exactly `{{field}}`, `{{amount}}` and `{{to}}`. The English pair is mirrored in `FIELD_DEFAULTS`. This adds keys and removes none. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `@object-ui/fields` `patch` and `@object-ui/i18n` `patch`, with `Metadata-protocol: none`. That is the level AGENTS.md sets for a widening outside the protocol, and no spec key, value or metadata type moves. `@object-ui/plugin-form` changes only in a test file, which is not published, so it correctly gets no entry. `main` is in Changesets pre mode (`next`); a `patch` entry is fine there.
- The `Clause-②:` line is the same in the PR body and the changeset. The changeset's widening paragraph lists the same four exports, the optional member and the union arm that ① finds.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty.
- `out_of_scope_findings`, first entry (branch B over a filled target, "not filed"): answered below as S1.
- `out_of_scope_findings`, second entry (a copied amount whose code becomes unset gets no note): answered. Point 2 of ruling 7118795825 names the record's current currency, and with none there is no code to name. This is acceptable as built, and the PR body says so.
- SQL push-down: the diff adds no data read, no id materialisation and no join. Nothing to find.
- Author: `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, so there is no outside login to name.
- S1 (should-fix) — For a withheld item that carries `held`, the branch B sentence tells the user to do something that does nothing. That item comes from a re-pick over a target an earlier pick filled. Once the record turns to the picked amount's currency, the note reads "…The record is now in EUR: pick again to fill €100.00. Unit Price still holds its earlier value." For a declared pair without `overwrite`, picking the same record again writes nothing, because `declaredPickWrites` skips a filled target that the previous record (now that same record) did not fill. The re-pick then clears the note, so the cell keeps the old amount and nothing explains why. I probed this read-only at this head: `planDeclaredLookupAutofill` with `previous` set to the picked record and the cell holding the earlier 50 returns `{"patch":{},"withheld":[]}`. The PR body and the dev report both record this case as "Noted, not filed". This PR adds the sentence, and it ships in 11 languages. Either of two fixes closes it: (a) in the `held` case, say to clear the field and then pick again, with a pin on both hosts; or (b) the seat files a follow-up card under #36412 that names the case, and the PR body cites it.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-36412-currency-change-notes`
Reviewed-by: `session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `a602513471817e4928b183ace2358b14b4b7072d` · 2026-11-25T13:41Z

- **Scope.** PR #37284 (card #36412): ruling 7118795825 「保留金额并提示」, all four points, and branch B 7158109013, on the line-item grid (`GridFieldWidget`) and the record form (`LookupField` with declared pairs). I read the whole net diff against merge base `057cedfa9b6`: 19 files. The same-head contract review is posted beside this one at `TIER_DEFAULT`: the declaration face, no `(narrowing)` arm, so the seat does not need to re-run it at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
- **Pins re-run at this head.** Throwaway worktree, closure built with `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`. Both pin files: 69 passed. With `-t ruling`: 9 passed, 5 on the grid and 4 on the form.
- **Point 1 (no amount changed or cleared): holds on both hosts, and no write is added.** The hosts gain only note state (`noteWithheld` and `setWithheldFills` carry `copied`) and render rows. There is no new `onAutofill`, `applyPatch` or `onChange` call, and `withheldAutofillNow` and `copiedAutofillNow` are pure. The pins assert the amount through each currency change and back: grid `unit_price` stays 100 (EUR→USD→EUR); form `unit_price` keeps 100 (USD→EUR→USD). A withheld cell stays empty, and a typed 70 or 55 is unchanged. Ablation: I injected a write that clears a pick-copied amount on a currency change (the option the ruling did not take). Grid run: 1 failed, at `GridField…test.tsx:640` (`expected null to be 100`). Form run: 1 failed, at `ObjectForm…test.tsx:744` (`expected '' to contain '100'`).
- **Point 2 (a copied amount is noted under its copied-under code and the code now): implemented and pinned on both hosts.** `judgeCopy` records `under` from the target's code after this pick's writes, and the hosts show the note only while the pick and the copied value both stand and the code now differs. Ablations, one host at a time with that host's `copiedShown` emptied: grid run 1 failed (grid copied test); form run 1 failed (form copied test). The other host stayed green each time.
- **Point 3 (a shown withheld note refreshes): implemented and pinned on both hosts.** Each host maps the shown items through `withheldAutofillNow` with the code now: `gridAutofillCurrency` on the current line, and `currencyFor({})` on the live record. Ablation, with the `.map(withheldAutofillNow…)` line removed one host at a time: grid run 2 failed (refresh and branch B); form run 2 failed (the same two).
- **Point 4 (a hand-typed amount gets no note): pinned on both hosts.** A typed amount was never picked, so it has no copied entry. A value typed over a copied amount fails the `sameValue` guard. Ablation, with the `sameValue` clause dropped from `copiedAutofillNow`: 3 failed (the hand-typed test on both hosts, plus the pure pin).
- **Branch B (note stays, cell stays empty, re-pick fills): holds, with no auto-fill.** `withheldAutofillNow` returns only a re-judged item, and nothing writes. Ablations: with the `nowSameCurrency` arm returning `item` unchanged, 3 failed (branch B on both hosts, plus the pure pin). Then an auto-fill of `amount` on `nowSameCurrency`, injected one host at a time: grid run 1 failed and form run 1 failed, each its own host's branch B test. The note disappears once the cell is filled, so the note-text assertion catches it before the empty-cell assertion. The form pins re-pick as a control. A read-only grid probe (the same pick again after the header turns to EUR) also fills 100 and clears the note.
- **Widening.** `copied` is optional and absent means none (pinned), so a producer narrows nothing. The `nowSameCurrency` arm does not narrow for consumers either. No repo consumer outside `ui/packages/fields` reads `WithheldAutofill` or its `reason`. The one reader inside the package (`withheldAutofillMessage`) is a ternary with a fallback and handles the arm. Only the new `withheldAutofillNow` emits it, so existing callers never see it at runtime. #36918 set the precedent by adding `targetCurrencyUnread` to the same union as additive. The changeset names the cost of an exhaustive switch. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` is right.
- **i18n.** The two new `lookup.*` keys are in all 11 packs. Placeholders match in every pack (`{{field}}`, `{{amount}}`, `{{to}}`). The English text is in `FIELD_DEFAULTS` too. The translations read correctly; zh-Hans and zh-Hant say 「记录现已改为 / 記錄現已改為」.
- **Changeset, sentence by sentence.** The title, the scope sentence (new record, no saved lines, staged lines), the three behaviour bullets and their quoted strings match `en.ts` and the pins. "The note goes away when the currency changes back or someone edits the amount" is true (`copiedAutofillNow`). "A currency change never fills a field by itself" is true (see the ablation above). The widening paragraph matches ①. Both packages are `patch` with `Metadata-protocol: none`, which is right; `plugin-form` changes only a test.
- **维护者速读, sentence by sentence.** 用户可见变化: correct apart from N2. 为什么做: correct; this is the card's last open item. 出错会怎样: correct; no amount is written or cleared, a hand-typed amount gets no note, and the PR reverts cleanly. 要你做什么：无: correct.
- **Check-runs at this head.** 62 runs: 47 `success`, 15 `skipped`, 0 failed. The combined status has 0 statuses. I could not take my own expected-skips reading: `check-expected-skips --pr 37284` exits 3 (NOT MEASURED), because this checkout's `ci.yml` is not main's tip. I rely on the zone's exit-0 reading in 7163698064, and the 15 skipped names are the usual ui-only set (Test Core and its planner, Build Core, the dogfood and queue legs, the opt-in harnesses).
- **K.** `landing-k --pr 37284` exits 3: the last green run (45619303836) ran no Test Core shard, so no `Affected-set diff base` was printed. As a stand-in, `git rev-list --count --first-parent` gives 15 from merge base `057cedfa9b6` to `origin/main` `875ae40f85b`, and 12 from GitHub's recorded base `622f3985fe5`. The zone takes the reading at landing.
- **merge-tree and overlap.** I ran the bare shared-clone probe (no driver) with both commits fetched: `merge-tree --write-tree` of `875ae40f85b` and the head exits 0, tree `ce68670af94`. #37264 (merged as `0ad44a32827`) touches `RequiredFieldsDialog.tsx`, `requiredWhenPrompt.ts`, its test and its changeset. It shares no file and no code path with this PR. Since the merge base, `main` changed only the 11 locale packs among this PR's files (9 lines in `en.ts`, none of them `lookup.*`), and they merge clean.
- **Size.** 19 files, +511/−36, or 547 changed lines. The 538 in the dispatch and in the PR's Verification block is the round-1 figure. With #36918 (+644/−70, 714 lines) the card totals 1,261, under 3,000.
- S1 (should-fix) — For a withheld item that carries `held` (a re-pick over a target an earlier pick filled), the branch B sentence gives an instruction that does nothing. After the record turns to the picked amount's currency, the note says "…pick again to fill €100.00. Unit Price still holds its earlier value." For a declared pair without `overwrite`, picking that record again writes nothing (`declaredPickWrites` skips a filled target that the previous record did not fill). It also clears the note, so the old amount stays and nothing explains why. I probed this read-only at this head: the re-pick plan is `{"patch":{},"withheld":[]}`. This PR adds the sentence (in 11 languages). The PR records the case as "Noted, not filed". Either fix closes it: (a) in the `held` case, say to clear the field and then pick again, pinned on both hosts; or (b) file a follow-up card under #36412 that names the case, and cite it in the PR body.
- N1 — The PR body's Verification block still says "Size: 19 files, +502/-36 (538 changed lines) … card totals 1,252", beside the correct round-2 line (547 and 1,261). Drop the stale line.
- N2 — 维护者速读 says 「改回与产品价格相同的币种时」. Branch B covers a record that changes *to* the picked price's currency. If the record had been in that currency at the pick, the price would have been copied, so 「改回」 misdescribes the usual case. Write 「改成」.
- N3 — The copied note names the copied-under currency only through the formatted amount ("copied as $100.00"). The ruling's example ("copied as USD 100") and the #36249 sentence (`{{amount}} in {{from}}`) also name the code. `Intl` symbol display does tell codes apart per locale (CA$, US$), so the note is not wrong. It is only less explicit than the voice the ruling cites.
- N4 — The grid has no re-pick control after branch B; only the form pins "a pick again fills it". The read-only probe above passes on the grid, so this is a missing pin, not a defect.
